main.description: A 花粉撲滅 remediation MAP — the aggregate readout over a set of forest stands (ADR-2606211712 + ADR-2606212030). Edge-primary pollen-source concentration is RECTIFIED (整流) into a prioritized restoration worklist routed to downstream actors (sanae/inochi/musubi/kamado) = the system of systems. A restoration MAP, NEVER a cut-list / target-list (G1/G2). ASSESSMENT + R0 DESIGN ONLY (G5).

routeTally.description: per-verdict aggregate: how many stands + how much burden routed to each sink

throughput.description: total pollen-burden across the stands ×1000 (fixed-point) — the flow kafun rectifies

orderIndex.description: 整流度 ×1000 (fixed-point): 1 − H(value)/H(volume) — how much scattered pollen-disorder was rectified into prioritized restoration order (ie-flow, ADR-2606212030)

eta.description: 共生 axis ×1000 (fixed-point): exported order ÷ consumed assessment cost (≫1 = a 利得, not a 課金される魔法陣)

restorationOnly.description: G1 — 撲滅 = restoration (主伐再造林); a 主伐 without 再造林 is :refuse :clearcut-without-reforest, never on this map as an actionable cut

isCutList.description: G2 — never a cut-list / target-list / cohort-affect map; no person-level data (:kafun.person/health unrepresentable)

neverActuates.description: G5 — kafun moves INFORMATION-energy (a prioritized map) only; physical forestry is the landowner's + operator/Council step

sourcing.description: R0 seed is :synthetic; real cadastral/satellite ingest is G7-gated

routeBucket.description: one verdict route's aggregate over the mapped stands

downstreamActor.description: the downstream SoS actor(s) this route feeds
